description: Cross-implementation fixtures for data/species.json. Any implementation reading this package must reproduce these outputs exactly. round_trip is the transcription check: each inch-pound table transcribed here is printed again in metric, so converting a cell must land on what the metric table prints, within the two printings' combined rounding.

conversion.note: Each property, the field it converts to in the metric printing of its table, the factor, and the tolerance. 5-3a was converted from 5-3b (footnote a), so there the tolerance is half 5-3a's rounding step. Tables 5-4 and 5-5 declare no derivation, so there it is half each printing's step.

handbook_internal_disagreements.note: Cells where the metric printing of a table is not a rounding of the inch-pound printing within their combined printed precision. The inch-pound table is canonical, so data/species.json carries that value and these rows are excluded from round_trip. Recorded, not reconciled.
handbook_internal_disagreements.labels_note: Row labels the two printings of a table spell differently. The inch-pound spelling is what handbook_label carries; the metric spelling is recorded here so the pairing stays checkable.

derived.note: Specific gravity to density is deferred: it needs the chapter 4 relation, and chapter 4 is not yet transcribed.
